preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner
Attacker must hold some amount of the CoinToken to exploit tax manipulation

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, set buy/sell taxes to 100% to steal all tokens from users. First, call setBuyTax(100,0,0,0) and setSellTax(100,0,0,0) to set maximum taxes. Then set tax wallets to attacker-controlled addresses using setTaxWallets(). Finally, trigger tax collection via triggerTax() or have users trade tokens to collect all funds into attacker wallets.
